description: ol-reserved-word (issue #427, M4 audit): `define axes ... end` redefines `axes`, a Geometry overlay primitive (spec/geometry-module.md's `## axes`). The static checker flags the procedure name at its own span, gated on the active `geometry` profile. Issue #838 dropped the `namespace: "primitive"` param (spec/error-model.md:125). The overlays are the deliberate counterpoint to `geometry/check/stdlib-names-are-definable`: `grid`/`axes`/`measure` are renderer-backed PRIMITIVES and so are built-in names, while `polygon`/`circle`/`arc`/`star`/`area`/`perimeter` are OpenLogo source and stay free to define (spec/grammar.md:412).
